purpose: Teach: フラメンコ/イケメン/ハングル/ヒップ/ヒーリング/ショパン/アキバ/レッズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフラメンコのショーをご覧になった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to go to flamenco shows.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic tone. Soft opening. Slow, measured pace like watching a memory surface. Slight warmth underneath. Voice trails off just barely at the end—not quite a question, more like wondering aloud to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃イケメンと評判だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and wasn't Grandpa quite the charmer back then, dear?
lines.style: Warm, teasing lilt. Quick tempo, almost playful. A little knowing laugh behind the words. Glances over at him while speaking—affectionate but with a gentle, private humor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがハングルを独学された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he taught himself Hangul.
lines.style: Same wistful quality as before. Opening soft and wondering. Slight pause before 'taught himself'—as if realizing the detail matters. Voice stays low, almost reverent about the effort involved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ダンスのヒップステップが上手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were quite the dancer too, weren't you, dear? Hip-hop steps and all.
lines.style: Warm, gently correcting/amused. Light, affectionate tone. A touch of playful exaggeration—she's testing him or teasing back. Voice slightly higher than normal, full of private amusement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヒーリング音楽をお好みだった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he really loved healing music.
lines.style: Voice softens even more here. Almost tender now, not just wistful. Slow, careful delivery—like he's protecting the memory. Gentle rising at the end, like he's inviting her to remember with him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ショパンのレコードを集められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You collected all those Chopin records, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, intimate, knowing smile in the voice. Slower than her previous lines—this one lands deeper. Affectionate and slightly conspiratorial, like she's reminding him of something he's learned to feel shy about.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアキバの電気街に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to spend time in Akiba's electronics district.
lines.style: Wistful as before, but with a tiny hint of gentle humor underneath—like he knows how this detail might sound to modern ears. Unhurried. Opens softly, holds the memory lightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、レッズの試合を観に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were a true Reds fan, going to all those baseball games, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, intimate close. Voice slightly softer than her other lines. Affectionate and reflective—she's wrapping up a moment. Slight trailing-off at the very end, tender and accepting, like she's letting the memory rest.
